title: Vault 313 Flooded Ruins
description: A woman in a flowing red coat and gas mask ascends a damaged staircase while holding a film reel. The derelict underground vault is flooded with dark water, features cracked walls covered in radiation symbols, torn movie posters, a submerged armchair, and a large framed portrait of a screaming woman.
prompt: A lone woman wearing a long red coat and gas mask climbs a broken staircase inside a flooded post-apocalyptic underground vault. Crumbling concrete walls display radiation hazard symbols and torn vintage movie posters. Dark water fills the lower level containing a submerged red armchair and a large portrait of a screaming woman. Film strips cascade down the stairs. Dramatic single spotlight from above, cinematic atmosphere, highly detailed digital painting.
